description: This file defines a singleton class `SettingsWindowOpener` responsible for opening the settings window within a macOS application. It provides mechanisms to register a custom settings action or fall back to default menu actions. It also defines a protocol for menu actions related to showing settings or preferences windows.

classes.name: SettingsWindowOpener
classes.description: A singleton class that manages opening the settings window in the application.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a custom action to open the settings window.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Activates the app and attempts to open the settings window, either via a registered action or by simulating menu item actions.
